concept.label: Four-chambered heart
concept.anchor: atrium, the right ventricle, the left atrium, and the left ventricle
concept.context: The heart's four chambers — right/left atria and ventricles — with the great vessels, beating in systole and diastole.

concept.label: SA node pacemaker

concept.context: Depolarisation starts at the SA node, crosses to the AV node, bundle of His and Purkinje fibres.

concept.label: Islets of Langerhans
concept.anchor: Embedded within the pancreatic parenchyma are the islets of Langerhans
concept.context: Endocrine cell clusters in the pancreas: alpha (glucagon), beta (insulin), delta (somatostatin).

spec.title: An islet of Langerhans
spec.caption: Beta cells (core) secrete insulin; alpha cells at the rim secrete glucagon.

concept.anchor: skeletal muscle fibers, where it is converted to glycogen for storage
concept.context: Blood glucose after a meal: insulin brings it down, glucagon raises it during fasting.

concept.label: Hypothalamus–pituitary axis
concept.anchor: projects to both the autonomic nervous system and the pituitary gland
concept.context: Hypothalamus integrates hormones/osmolarity/temperature and drives the pituitary.

spec.title: Hypothalamus–pituitary axis
spec.caption: Hypothalamus integrates hormones/osmolarity/temperature and drives the pituitary.
spec.body_markdown:
The **hypothalamus** controls the **anterior pituitary** through releasing hormones carried by the hypophyseal portal system, and the **posterior pituitary** directly through axons that release oxytocin and ADH [1].

*"The pituitary gland ... is often called the master gland, though it is itself controlled by the hypothalamus."* [2]
